gateway_dns.unit:
# Managed by Orbit.
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Gateway DNS routing
After=wg-quick@orbit.service
ConditionPathExists=/sys/class/net/orbit
ConditionPathExists=!/etc/wireguard/orbit.dns-link

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/resolvectl domain orbit ~orbit
ExecStart=/usr/bin/resolvectl default-route orbit false
ExecStart=/usr/bin/resolvectl dns orbit 10.44.0.1

[Install]
WantedBy=wg-quick@orbit.service
